demand_slide.note: Each block carries the tag its signals put on the map. Rows marked “all” apply across the whole map, so they drive no individual tag — DIANA's challenge areas are the clearest case. Sources: NATO, NCIA and Oracle public statements, September 2026; cases with no tag are backed by allied national programmes (US, UK, Germany, the Netherlands) instead.

ft_slide.title: The FreeTech delivered cases
ft_slide.note: SoftServe's delivered defence work as listed on the FreeTech one-pager (six cases, SoftServe Confidential); each case carries the violet pill it puts on the map. Orange pills on the map are SoftServe deliveries on Oracle: Riyadh Air — contract extraction (1.2) · Bosch — workforce scheduling (4.2).

c1.name: Autonomous last-mile air delivery
c1.desc: a delivery drone that flies itself when the link is lost

items.signal: Fail-safe AI navigation under lost pilot link, GPS or signal: real-time monitoring and obstacle avoidance keep the aircraft flying until it finishes the delivery or diverts to a safe location on its own.

c2.name: Foresight analytics engine
c2.desc: an analysis engine for an intelligence desk

items.signal: Fuses multi-source data for faster threat detection and decision-making; an integrated platform automates routine analysis and turns fragmented data into actionable, customisable intelligence reports.

c3.name: Radio cluster intelligence
c3.desc: makes sense of raw radio traffic for an operator

items.signal: Automated RF signal clustering surfaces patterns and emerging activity in real time; clustering, pattern recognition and multi-layer visualisation turn raw signal data into actionable insight.

c4.name: Operations control tower
c4.desc: the operations picture on one screen

items.signal: Real-time tracking of fleet readiness, missions and resource allocation; one platform combines mission tracking, performance analytics and maintenance planning to drive data-based operational decisions.

c5.name: UUV digital twin
c5.desc: a virtual underwater vehicle instead of physical tests

items.signal: A digital twin for depths of 50–250 ft, built on a coupled CFD/PINN physics model and visualised in NVIDIA Omniverse; physics-informed simulation cut underwater-vehicle testing time and cost.

c6.name: EdgeInsight visual intelligence
c6.desc: cameras that inspect and spot hazards on the device itself

items.signal: NVIDIA-powered edge vision for real-time inspection and safety monitoring: a modular accelerator on Jetson/DeepStream with TAO, deployed and updated over the air at scale, even offline.

criteria_slide.title: How the use cases were selected

criteria.name: Proof we can show
criteria.desc: a delivered SoftServe case behind it: FreeTech C1–C6, Riyadh Air or Bosch on Oracle, or a funded pipeline client

criteria.name: Runs on the Oracle + NVIDIA stack
criteria.desc: built on OCI + NeMo (AI-Q, VSS or other NVIDIA models) or on AIDP / AI Lakehouse — not a generic cloud workload

criteria.name: A NATO demand signal
criteria.desc: a named sign that NCIA or another NATO body wants this — a programme, tender, strategy line or public statement (slide 2)

criteria.name: Low risk, tangible return
criteria.desc: unclassified or synthetic data path, GA components, a baseline to measure against, 4–8 weeks to a visible result with a KPI readout
